The Child She Chose to Forget

Three‑year‑old Mopsy once had a complete family. Out of sympathy for Ellie, daughter of her sick friend, mother Laura devotes most of her care to the girl, even asking her biological daughter Mopsy to call her aunt in public. Repeatedly overlooked and hurt, Mopsy is filled with grief. Father Daniel sees the truth and stands firmly to protect his daughter. After custody conflicts and emotional struggles, Laura wakes up to her mistakes. Supported by her father, Mopsy heals her wounds. The family faces rifts head‑on, learning about love and responsibility for reconciliation and a new start.
